payload.name: Signature 256x64 Under 20KB by PrintableTools Lab
payload.short_description: Free no-signup 256 x 64 signature workflow for strict 20KB upload limits.
payload.long_description: A free browser-based 256 x 64 signature under 20KB workflow for portals that validate both exact signature pixels and a strict file-size cap. It points to local resize and compression steps, requires no account and no server file upload, and includes an optional USD 9 Upload Limit Fix Plan request after a public-safe fit check.
